descriptions.text: Hackers with unauthorized access to the exchange’s hot wallets had stolen roughly $60 million in bitcoin, bitcoin cash, and MonaCoin. That being said, the exact amount of bitcoin cash stolen remains unknown.

Zaif, a Japanese cryptocurrency exchange, suffered a hot wallet key compromise on September 14, 2018, resulting in the theft of approximately $60 million in BTC, Bitcoin Cash, and MonaCoin. The attackers exploited poor wallet security to access and drain assets. Unauthorized access to Zaif’s hot wallet was enabled by compromised credentials, allowing attackers to obtain the private key or API access and execute large fund withdrawals. Lack of real-time monitoring or robust anomaly detection allowed the theft to proceed unnoticed.
